question: What condition must hold for the act of applying meditation to follow the worship of this circle in the prescribed practice?
premises: Worship of the circle must precede the application of meditation.
The application of meditation is limited to the duration specified by the condition.
The practice links worship and meditation into a single sequential act.
inference: Meditation is applied only for as long as the prescribed condition holds after worshipping the circle.
uncertainties: The exact temporal scope of yāvat remains context-dependent.
plain_english: Having worshipped this circle, one applies meditation for as long as the prescribed condition holds.
